name: Marta Algereach
original_name: マルタ・アルゲリーチ
source:
An up and coming treasure hunter who has recently reared her head. In contrast to her chosen profession, she is not especially attached to money and does not appear to be very aware of the stigma of being a treasure hunter.

It seems that in her past somewhere lies a connection with Kasumi.

[Edited from Hirameki International]
